name: depot-mcp
description: Read-only access to Depot CI failure diagnosis, container build forensics, registry, and usage.
long_description: Read-only Model Context Protocol server for Depot, the container build and CI acceleration service at depot.dev. Answers "why did CI fail?" and "why did this build fail?" using Depot's own failure diagnosis, plus run history, cache effectiveness, registry contents, CI configuration, and usage. No tool can change anything in Depot. Community project, not affiliated with Depot.

depot_token.title: Depot Organization token
depot_token.description: Create one in the Depot dashboard under Organization Settings > API Tokens. Project tokens do not work. This token can also write to Depot; the server never uses it to do so.

depot_org_id.title: Organization ID (optional)
depot_org_id.description: Only needed if the token can see more than one organization. depot_whoami will tell you.

depot_project_id.title: Default project ID (optional)
depot_project_id.description: Default container-build project, so build tools can be called without naming one.

tools.name: depot_diagnose_ci_failure
tools.description: Why did this CI run, workflow, job, or attempt fail? Clustered root causes, diagnosis, suggested fix, evidence lines.

tools.name: depot_diagnose_build
tools.description: Why did this container build fail? Failing step, its error and log tail, cache effectiveness.

tools.name: depot_whoami
tools.description: Is the token valid and what can it see? Detects multi-organization ambiguity.

tools.name: depot_list_ci_runs
tools.description: Recent CI runs filtered by status, repo, SHA, trigger, or PR.

tools.name: depot_get_ci_run
tools.description: One run's workflow, job, and attempt tree with statuses.

tools.name: depot_get_ci_job
tools.description: One job's status, error, runner labels, timing, and every attempt.

tools.name: depot_get_ci_attempt
tools.description: One attempt's status, error, sandbox id, and timing.

tools.name: depot_list_ci_workflows
tools.description: Recent CI workflows with job counts, filtered by name, status, repo, SHA, trigger, or PR.

tools.name: depot_get_ci_workflow
tools.description: One workflow's rerun history and its job and attempt tree.

tools.name: depot_get_ci_logs
tools.description: Bounded raw logs for an attempt: tail by default, grep, step and stream filters.

tools.name: depot_get_ci_job_summary
tools.description: The markdown a job published about itself.

tools.name: depot_get_ci_metrics
tools.description: CPU and memory for a run, job, or attempt.

tools.name: depot_list_ci_artifacts
tools.description: Artifacts a run uploaded, with optional signed download URLs.

tools.name: depot_list_builds
tools.description: Recent container builds with duration and cache hit ratio.

tools.name: depot_list_projects
tools.description: Build projects with region, hardware, and cache policy.

tools.name: depot_get_project
tools.description: One project's configuration and OIDC trust policies.

tools.name: depot_get_usage
tools.description: Build minutes, minutes saved by cache, runner minutes, storage, sandboxes.

tools.name: depot_list_images
tools.description: Registry contents for a project with digests and sizes.

tools.name: depot_list_ci_secrets
tools.description: CI secret names and scoping. Values are never returned.

tools.name: depot_list_ci_variables
tools.description: CI variables with values and scoping; credential-shaped values are redacted.

prompts.name: diagnose-latest-failure
prompts.description: Find the most recent failed run, diagnose it, and propose a fix.
prompts.text: Find my most recent failed Depot CI run, diagnose why it failed, and propose a fix.

prompts.name: explain-build-slowness
prompts.description: Look at recent builds and usage to explain whether slowness is cache misses or more work.
prompts.text: Look at my recent Depot container builds and usage and explain whether they are slow because of cache misses or because there is more work.
